description.narrative: Stakeholder effects: Uzbekistan faces a significant housing deficit and IFC expects that the proposed project will increase access to housing finance in the country. Most of the population faces challenges in accessing housing finance due to insufficient mortgage financing products offered by commercial banks. It is anticipated that the project may also promote access to mortgage finance for women by dedicating certain amount of the proceeds to this sub-segment. By supporting UzMRC, IFC expects that the project will also promote the competitiveness of the domestic mortgage market though the capacity building channel.

The proposed investment entails up to US$45 million equivalent of UZS denominated 3-year bullet fixed-rate senior financing to the JSC Mortgage Refinancing Company of Uzbekistan (UzMRC or the Company), which will be extendible for an additional 3-years, to support UzMRC to refinance the retail mortgage portfolios of private banks and specific state-owned financial institutions (the Project). Certain portion of the proceeds might be used by UzMRC for mortgage loans provided to womens housing finance.
